property_summary: Only the current owner may change ownership: a transferOwnership call from any non-owner reverts and leaves c.owner() unchanged, while a call from the current owner succeeds and sets the owner to the requested new owner; the mutant's stripped onlyOwner modifier lets any caller succeed and take ownership.
change_summary: Remove the _checkOwner() call so the onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts transferOwnership to the owner.
